column1: # derivation: §5.3: an integer BIN_DIV or BIN_MOD whose divisor is zero
# answers NULL for that row, and raises no error; the literal 0 is INT64
# (§8.19), so every row of every computed column is NULL, over the
# nullable a and the non-nullable id alike; for id 8 (a NULL) a_div_0 and
# a_mod_0 are NULL by §5.0, which is checked before the divisor. Types: INT64 (§5.1, §8.10, and
# §8.9 for same-typed operands), nullable by §8's default, which §5.3's
# NULLs require even though id is non-nullable.
